subject: Request: executive signoff for VPC data-residency & audit terms (Acme Robotics)
messages:
From: James Morgan <james.morgan@acme-robotics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-robotics.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: VPC deployment + audit access questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Procurement has a couple of non-standard asks before we can circulate the SOW for signature:

- Data residency: All production data must remain in AWS eu-west-1 (no cross-region backups).
- Audit rights: Acme legal needs the ability to perform an annual compliance review that includes access to audit logs and the option for an on-site audit of the private deployment (with 30 days' notice).
- KMS / key management: We prefer to manage keys via our KMS (customer-managed keys).

We appreciate Redwood's standard terms but these are deal-breakers for us. Budget team is also asking whether you can accommodate a 25% first-year volume discount in exchange for a 36-month commitment.

Timeline: procurement would like a redline and signoff window by 2026-11-16 to hit their board review.

Can you confirm who on your side needs to sign off on the audit/data-residency exceptions?

Best,
James
James Morgan
Head of Procurement, Acme Robotics
attachments: Acme_RFI_vpc_requirements.xlsx (referenced)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Morgan <james.morgan@acme-robotics.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: VPC deployment + audit access questions

Team — escalating for legal/pricing triage. Quick summary: Acme wants EU-only residency, on-site audit rights, and customer KMS. They are also asking for a 25% first-year discount with a 36-month commit.

Attached: Acme_SOW_draft_v2.docx and our stock VPC audit addendum (redwood_vpc_audit_addendum_v1.pdf).

Asks:
- Laura: Can you review the audit/on-site language and tell me what we can safely offer (redline attached). What would require exec legal signoff?
- Rishi: Pricing — is a 25% first-year discount within delegated authority? If not, what is the max we can pre-approve while we route for exec approval?
- Markus: Operational risk — can the infra team commit to EU-only residency and support for customer-managed KMS in a Private deployment? Any hidden costs or limitations?

Procurement needs a clear path to signing by 11/16. If we need C-suite signoff, please advise who to loop and a succinct recommendation I can send to James.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0192
attachments: Acme_SOW_draft_v2.docx; redwood_vpc_audit_addendum_v1.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: VPC deployment + audit access questions

Vanessa — quick legal read. High-level notes:

- Data residency: EU-only hosting is operationally feasible; need to lock region in contract and add SLA language prohibiting cross-region backups without written consent. That is standard and I can add it.

- Audit rights: On-site, unrestricted audits are high risk. Two options we can offer:
  1) Remote compliance review with production log exports and a mutually agreed scope (no on-site) — low risk.
  2) On-site audit limited to pre-approved controls, during business hours, with a signed NDA and pre-notice window; Redwood retains the right to have a Redwood engineer present. This is possible but will require indemnity and scope limits; legal must approve specific language.

- KMS: Customer-managed keys are supported in the Private deployment flavor, but we need to document operational responsibilities and key-rotation windows. Technical appendix required.

Pricing/discount: 25% first-year discount exceeds our standard delegated approval for deals of this size. Recommend we counter with a 15% first-year discount plus a structured SOW for the audit addendum (cost-recovery clause for on-site audit expenses). If they insist on an on-site audit, we should charge a one-time audit facilitation fee.

I attached a redline (legal_redline_vpc_audit.docx) with recommended language and a short exec memo (two bullets) that summarizes the risk and recommended deal guardrails. If we go for on-site audit rights, this requires exec legal + GC signoff.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: legal_redline_vpc_audit.docx

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: VPC deployment + audit access questions

Vanessa / team — pricing and deal desk perspective:

Deal summary: Acme is targeting an ARR-equivalent of ~$1.1M for year one under the proposed seat/usage mix. They requested 25% first-year.

Delegation: Our deal desk can approve up to 10% on this band given margin constraints. Anything above 10% requires head of sales / CRO + finance signoff. Since this would be a 25% ask, we need executive approval.

Recommendations:
- Counter at 15% first-year, with a 12-month price step-up to contractual rate in year two (or a 36-month commit at 18% effective).
- Agree to EU-only residency and KMS with the legal redlines Laura provided.
- If they insist on an on-site audit, charge a one-time facilitation fee (estimate $12k) and cap audit scope.

HubSpot: HS-20045 (I added the pricing scenarios and renewal table).

If we need a single exec signature route: request to Markus for signoff on >10% discount and acceptance of limited on-site audit terms. Otherwise, this will go to the Deal Review Committee / COO.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: pricing_scenarios_ACME.xlsx

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, James Morgan <james.morgan@acme-robotics.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: ACTION: executive signoff request — Acme Robotics (HS-20045)

Markus — forwarding a compact ask for exec signoff. Acme requires EU-only data residency, support for customer-managed KMS on our Private offering, and limited audit rights. They are asking for 25% first-year discount on a 36-month commit.

Summary (recommendation):
- Approve: EU-only residency + KMS support with legal redlines (Laura)
- Approve: 18% first-year effective discount (blended over 36 months) instead of 25% — this preserves margin while being competitive (Rishi can circulate the blended math).
- Conditional approve: on-site audit limited to scope in legal_redline_vpc_audit.docx, with a one-time facilitation fee and pre-notice; GC signoff on final language required.

If you approve, I'll send an executive approval memo to James and route the contract to DocuSign. If not, please indicate which items you will not approve so I can present a single counter. Procurement wants clarity by 2026-11-16.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
